draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 208th-best grade among 241 2018 draftees and 30th of 32 at WR. He went 175th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (208th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 694 receiving yards in 2017, 24th of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 31 career games and 6 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2019. Weak spots: team target share 2.0% (16th percentile), approximate value 1 (18th percentile).
